final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) as count_distinct FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count_distinct) as total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.throws, step1.count_distinct, CAST(step1.count_distinct AS REAL) / step2.total_count as proportion FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.throws, step3.count_distinct, step3.proportion, step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as difference FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion) SELECT SUM(step5.count_distinct) as sum_count, AVG(step5.proportion) as avg_proportion_filtered, AVG(step5.difference) as avg_difference FROM step5
